**Finding: compliant (rule effectively not applicable).**

- **No renewal mechanic exists.** § 2 (p0011) creates an evergreen term running "until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6"; there is no auto-renewal, no renewal term, and no non-renewal notice window. Document-wide searches for renewal/extension language returned nothing.
- **Exit is easier than the fallback.** § 6(a) permits either party to terminate "for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice" when no SOW is outstanding, so there is no notice window for us to miss and no multi-year lock-in (walk-away territory not implicated).
- **Both checklists are conditional on automatic renewal**, so no preferred or fallback element is triggered; no redline proposed.
- **Noted only:** § 3(b) lets Contractor "change rates with 30 days notice" without a cap. That is a mid-term pricing right, not a renewal uplift, so it sits under the pricing rule rather than being double-flagged here.
